messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — pocket LAN tomorrow 6pm at the kitchen island. Bring handhelds, controllers, snacks.
Maya: Also shout if you can bring extra power banks or a projector (short throw).
Tom: I can bring my mini projector + short HDMI (has tripod). I also have a 3-outlet power strip.
Jess: Bringing Switch OLED + an 18k mAh PD bank I can share.
Liam: Im bringing a Steam Deck (undocked) + 65W PD charger and a USB-C hub.
Andre: Ill grab a handful of spare USB-A cables and a wall wart. Happy to lug whatever big power bricks needed.
Caroline: Can someone bring extra controllers? My Pro Controller is out of juice. :cry:
Maya: Ill bring two extra Joy‑Cons and the multi-USB charging hub.
Jess: Quick poll — background music? React in thread: :game_die: chiptune / :cd: synthwave / :mute: silence.
Tom: :game_die: chiptune from me.
Liam: :cd: synthwave for warmups.
Andre: Silence for the intense boss runs pls.
Caroline: Also — is there an HDMI->USB-C adapter for the projector?
Tom: Yup projector accepts HDMI; I have an HDMI->USB-C dongle too.
Maya: Perfect. Parking note: leave one visitor spot near loading dock for folks bringing gear.
Jess: I made a quick list — whos bringing what:
Jess: - Maya: joycons + hub
Jess: - Tom: projector + HDMI + power strip
Jess: - Jess: Switch + PD bank
Jess: - Liam: Steam Deck + charger + hub
Jess: - Andre: cables + spare wall wart
Caroline: If anyone has an extra dock for Switch-to-TV I'd borrow it for a couple matches.
Maya: I can bring a tiny dock.
calendar-bot: Event created — "Pocket LAN @ kitchen" tomorrow 18:00, invited Maya, Tom, Jess, Liam, Andre, Caroline.
Tom: Oh and FYI, bring surge protector if youre plugging expensive stuff. Last time the breakout strip died.
Andre: Noted. Ill bring a heavy-duty strip.
Liam: Who wants to sign up for the roguelike co-op slot? 4 players max.
Jess: Ill take a slot.
Maya: In for co-op.
Caroline: Sitting this one out for spectating and snack management. :popcorn:
Tom: Same — Ill run projector ops and snack procurement.
Maya: Cool. See everyone tomorrow — bring chargers, good vibes, and maybe a ridiculous cosplay if you want. :joystick:
